metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 30 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about temperature differences in Boston, MA between January 29 and February 5, 2019. I need to: 1. Find air temperature data at 2 meters height 2. Calculate the highest daily temperature for each day in that period 3. Check if there's at least a 30°C difference between the highest and lowest daily maximum temperatures For temperature data, I should use ERA5 (ECMWF Reanalysis v5) which provides 2m temperature data. The band is 'mean_2m_air_temperature'. Strategy: - Define Boston geometry (Point) - Get ERA5 data for the date range - Extract maximum temperature for each day - Calculate the range (max - min) of daily maximum temperatures - Check if range >= 30°C I need to handle: - Empty collection (C1) - No valid pixels (C2) - Calculation failures (C3) - Valid data (A/B) Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const boston = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.0589, 42.3601]); const startDate = '2019-01-29'; const endDate = '2019-02-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5 for 2m temperature const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(boston) .select('mean_2m_air_temperature_max'); const collectionSize = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Extract daily maximum temperatures const tempData = era5.map(function(image) { const date = image.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'); const maxTemp = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: boston, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mean_2m_air_temperature_max'); return ee.Feature(null, { 'date': date, 'max_temp': maxTemp }); }); const tempList = tempData.aggregate_array('max_temp').getInfo(); const dateList = tempData.aggregate_array('date').getInfo(); console.log("Daily max temperatures (K):"); for (let i = 0; i < dateList.length; i++) { console.log(`${dateList[i]}: ${tempList[i]?.toFixed(2) || 'No data'}`); } // 4. Check for valid data and calculate range const validTemps = tempList.filter(temp => temp !== null && temp !== undefined); if (validTemps.length === 0) { console.log("No valid temperature data"); console.log("C2"); return; } const maxTempK = Math.max(...validTemps); const minTempK = Math.min(...validTemps); const rangeK = maxTempK - minTempK; const rangeC = rangeK - 273.15; // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius console.log(`Max daily temp: ${(maxTempK - 273.15).toFixed(1)}°C`); console.log(`Min daily temp: ${(minTempK - 273.15).toFixed(1)}°C`); console.log(`Temperature range: ${rangeC.toFixed(1)}°C`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (isNaN(rangeC) || rangeC < -100 || rangeC > 100) { console.log("C3"); } else if (rangeC >= 30) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
